from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=17.68, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 4.48 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.99, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 5.7 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=12.91, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 2.7 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.95, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 8.89 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=9.0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 9.73 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.6, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 7.96 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.39, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 5.53 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.97, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_7')
    lin_expr += 2.47 * vars['Var_7']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(5.16 * vars['Var_3'] + 9.02 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.7 * vars['Var_7'] >= 149.93, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(2.81 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.86 * vars['Var_1'] + 9.61 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.02 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.49 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.67 * vars['Var_5'] >= 220.83, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(3.15 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.0 * vars['Var_1'] + 8.79 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.25 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.44 * vars['Var_6'] >= 217.67, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(7.44 * vars['Var_1'] + 0.06 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.84 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.71 * vars['Var_6'] >= 122.29, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(8.53 * vars['Var_2'] + 1.02 * vars['Var_4'] + 0.39 * vars['Var_6'] >= 60.8, name='C4')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m

Subject: Cost-Minimizing Mix to Meet Service Commitments Across Five Lines

Team,

We need to assemble a lowest-cost portfolio of service capacity to meet our contractual and regulatory commitments across five lines of work this period: Emergency Coverage, Preventive Maintenance, New Installations, Quality Inspections, and Warranty Support. Each option below can be deployed within its availability limits and contributes specific amounts of capacity to those lines. Our goal is to minimize total spend while meeting the minimum commitments stated at the end of this memo.

The levers we can use

- Community Maintenance Squads (whole squads only)
  • Cost: 4.48 per squad deployed.  
  • Availability: we may deploy anywhere from 0 up to 17.68 squads; squads must be booked in whole units.  
  • Impact: each squad provides 2.81 units toward Preventive Maintenance and 3.15 units toward New Installations. These squads do not contribute to Emergency Coverage, Quality Inspections, or Warranty Support.

- Regional Flex Technicians (scalable hours)
  • Cost: 5.70 per block of capacity.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 10.99 blocks; can be fractional.  
  • Impact: each block delivers 6.86 units of Preventive Maintenance, 8.00 units of New Installations, and 7.44 units of Quality Inspections. No contribution to Emergency Coverage or Warranty Support.

- Outsourced Preventive Pods (scalable hours)
  • Cost: 2.70 per block of capacity.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 12.91 blocks; can be fractional.  
  • Impact: each block adds 9.61 units to Preventive Maintenance, 8.79 units to New Installations, and 8.53 units to Warranty Support. No contribution to Emergency Coverage or Quality Inspections.

- Emergency Response Teams (whole teams only)
  • Cost: 8.89 per team deployed.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 6.95 teams; teams must be booked in whole units.  
  • Impact: each team contributes 5.16 units to Emergency Coverage, 4.02 units to Preventive Maintenance, and 0.06 units to Quality Inspections. No contribution to New Installations or Warranty Support.

- Premium Installation Contractors (whole crews only)
  • Cost: 9.73 per crew deployed.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 9.00 crews; crews must be booked in whole units.  
  • Impact: each crew supplies 5.49 units of Preventive Maintenance, 6.25 units of New Installations, and 1.02 units of Warranty Support. No contribution to Emergency Coverage or Quality Inspections.

- Rapid Response Packages (scalable hours)
  • Cost: 7.96 per package.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 13.60 packages; can be fractional.  
  • Impact: each package yields 9.02 units of Emergency Coverage, 2.67 units of Preventive Maintenance, and 2.84 units of Quality Inspections. No contribution to New Installations or Warranty Support.

- Quality & Retrofit Specialists (scalable hours)
  • Cost: 5.53 per block of capacity.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 10.39 blocks; can be fractional.  
  • Impact: each block contributes 6.44 units to New Installations, 6.71 units to Quality Inspections, and 0.39 units to Warranty Support. No contribution to Emergency Coverage or Preventive Maintenance.

- Night Emergency Cover (scalable hours)
  • Cost: 2.47 per block of capacity.  
  • Availability: anywhere from 0 up to 13.97 blocks; can be fractional.  
  • Impact: each block supplies 6.70 units of Emergency Coverage only. No contribution to Preventive Maintenance, New Installations, Quality Inspections, or Warranty Support.

Market limits and minimum commitments

- Emergency Coverage: at least 149.93 units must be delivered.  
- Preventive Maintenance: at least 220.83 units must be delivered.  
- New Installations: at least 217.67 units must be delivered.  
- Quality Inspections: at least 122.29 units must be delivered.  
- Warranty Support: at least 60.80 units must be delivered.

Please use the above as the basis for identifying the least expensive mix that satisfies all minimums without exceeding the stated availability for each option.
